text:
Mira: Heads up — got a customer ticket where the console showed a duplicate toolcall charge after a client reconnect + truncated stream. Screenshot pasted: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/abc123
Alex: I remember a similar blip last week. Is this the one where the client resumed with a new session token?
Mira: Yep. Repro steps boiled down to: start streaming, client times out mid-token, reconnect with same session_id but sends a new toolcall block. Console shows PROVISIONAL charge then FINAL charge, but both include the toolcall token count.
Sam: Can you paste the minimal logs?
Mira: Logs (sanitized):
```
2026-03-07T16:03:12Z event=stream_start session=svc-73a id=abc toolcall_id=tc1
2026-03-07T16:03:15Z event=provisional_charge session=svc-73a amount=45 reason=prefix
2026-03-07T16:03:18Z event=client_disconnect session=svc-73a
2026-03-07T16:03:22Z event=stream_resume session=svc-73a resume_token=xyz
2026-03-07T16:03:22Z event=toolcall session=svc-73a toolcall_id=tc2 amount=40
2026-03-07T16:03:25Z event=finalize_charge session=svc-73a amount=85 matched_toolcall=tc2
```
Mira: Notice provisional_charge and final both include toolcall tokens; tc1 never finalized, tc2 did — console credited both.
Jon: That matches the ledger entries I pulled. We create provisional row when we see the prefix. If the resumed stream issues a new toolcall_id we currently don't dedupe provisional -> final by session+toolcall heuristics.
Kiran: Is the root problem attribution keys? We currently index provisional rows by session + provisional_prefix_id, but toolcalls get a separate key. If resume changes toolcall_id we lose the link.
Alex: Options: 1) add explicit provisional.session_id + related_toolcall_id pointer when we create provisional rows (best-effort), 2) require clients to include previous toolcall_id in resume (breaking), 3) UI side: show provisional grouped by session and mark "unmatched" until final reconciliation.
Sam: UX workaround first would be easiest: group provisional by session_id in console and hide provisional from billing view until reconciliation. But ops will hate delayed visibility.
Mira: Customer-facing concern: they saw immediate double-count and emailed billing. We need to avoid visible double-charge even if backend is provisional.
Jon: Backend fix: when final_charge arrives, run a fuzzy-match to consume provisional rows by session + overlap heuristic (token range overlap) and mark provisional as consumed instead of leaving both. This avoids double-show.
Kiran: We should also add a telemetry counter: `token_accounting.discrepancy.reconciled_by_heuristic` and `token_accounting.unmatched_provisional_count`. Helps measure impact.
Alex: Agreed. Also add `charge_reason` tag with values {prefix, final, toolcall} on ledger events and include `session_id` and `toolcall_id` in the billing event payload. Makes UI grouping trivial.
Mira: Small query: does this break audits? We need final settlement to be deterministic and replayable. Any heuristic must be idempotent.
Jon: Heuristic: pick provisional rows with same session and overlapping prefix hash within 5s of final. Deterministic if we sort by provisional_ts asc and consume top-down. Documented in ledger migration.
Sam: For short-term: 1) UI hide provisional from invoice export, 2) add note in console: "Provisional charges shown for live debugging only — not invoiced until finalized", 3) onboard the telemetry.
Mira: I'll file a small infra PR to add the `charge_reason` + session/toolcall fields in event schema and create an alert if unmatched provisional > 5 in 10m for any org.
Kiran: I'll prototype the reconcile job and the deterministic consume rule. Jon, can you own the UI grouping change?
Jon: Yep, will sketch a console mock and the API change to return grouped rows: `{group_id, entries[], provisional_sum, final_sum, state}`.
Mira: Thanks. Assigning follow-ups: Mira -> event schema PR, Kiran -> reconcile job prototype, Jon -> console grouping + API, Sam -> telemetry/alert. We'll sync tomorrow at 10. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Note: when `charge_reason` field is present, billing export will include `charge_reason` and `related_toolcall_id`. Legacy exports unaffected.
